title: Kinetic fan
headline:
Choose your first
AI project.
description: Broad colored blades open from a point below the frame. Different lengths and deliberate gaps give the silhouette movement while the blue field stays quiet.
patternRule: Use six or seven broad tapered blades, with gently rounded ends and irregular lengths. Crop the point of convergence below the frame; preserve space around the headline.
gradientRule: Flat color throughout. Depth comes from the sequence of blue, cyan, and one lime blade, rather than a background glow.

title: Woven loop
headline:
Choose your first
AI project.
description: Two broad loops weave through one another above the headline. The cropped curves and small lime crossing give the composition a playful, sculptural rhythm.
patternRule: Pair two generous asymmetric elliptical ribbons. Give each a different angle and proportion; weave one crossing over and one under. Keep the lower-left headline area open.
gradientRule: Flat forest and blue ribbons with a small lime crossing. White space provides the contrast; no gradient or shadow.

title: Slanted rhythm
headline:
Choose your first
AI project.
description: Bold angled capsules rise through the edge in uneven lengths. Their spacing and staggered ends create a graphic rhythm without becoming a diagram or interface.
patternRule: Use broad parallel capsules at one decisive angle. Vary their lengths and end positions; keep the gaps even and let the frame crop the final bars.
gradientRule: Flat pale blue base and solid colored capsules. One lime bar breaks the blue-and-forest sequence; no gradient.
